name: ruff
description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
one_liner: A tool that instantly checks Python code for mistakes and messy formatting, much faster than older tools.
buyer: An engineering lead at a Python shop who wants cleaner code without slowing down their CI pipeline.
business_use_cases: A consultancy sells a codebase-cleanup service: run it across a client's legacy Python repo, auto-fix thousands of issues, bill as a fixed-price project.
A tooling vendor bundles it into a 'Python code quality as a service' product with dashboards for engineering managers.
A course creator sells a 'ship clean Python fast' workshop centered on modern tooling like this.

money_ideas.idea: One-off legacy-codebase cleanup service using automatic fixes
Code-quality dashboard SaaS built on top of its output

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'run it across your repo and fix everything automatically' cleanup service to Python shops this weekend.
